integrity: Complete proof, exact convention, explicit first-order and endpoint expansions, self-contained independent-coordinate checker. No independent audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Only a similarity class of regular icosahedra in Euclidean three-space and invariant directional widths. General coarea formulae already exist. Historical priority regarding incompletely accessible polyhedral-width literature remains uncertain. Numerical checks do not replace the proof.
title: Exact directional-width distribution and sharp critical laws of the regular icosahedron
